verdict.rationale: Glama publishes an OpenAPI 3.0.3 'Glama MCP API' with /v1 paths for servers, connectors, instances and usage. It is discoverable via llms.txt and an RFC 9727 API catalog, and backed by a hosted reference with per-endpoint Try-it panels, multi-language samples and machine-readable deprecation flags. The probe 404s at generic paths do not contradict this, because the spec lives at /api/mcp/openapi.json. Missing for 10: the API covers the directory/hosting surface, while the Gateway (MCP-protocol only) and chat features have no REST API; there is no versioning or changelog policy page; and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of driving the product via the API.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
